name: Fashion
overview: Produced by Andy Warhol between 1979–1980 for Manhattan Cable, Fashion was a 10-episode series delving into runway culture, designers (like Halston), models, and makeup. It featured Warhol’s deadpan intros, SX-70 Polaroids, and a fly-on-the-wall style, bridging art, celebrity, and consumerism before MTV's Fifteen Minutes.
